verdict.rationale: Outlook's first-party REST/Graph mail API lets programs draft, send and manage mail, set rules, and receive change notifications without the client UI, from any platform that can send HTTP requests. That supports headless automation, but nothing documents a CLI, CI-specific usage, or non-interactive app-only authentication for pipelines. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented non-interactive/service-principal auth for CI, CI integration guidance, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
